repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python to provide granular visibility into agentic workflows.
Tracks specific metrics including token consumption, latency, file modifications, and test execution results.
Enables financial accountability for engineering teams by mapping agent tasks to actual operational costs.
Supports integration with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first, high-performance dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Uses deterministic computational logic for market metrics like limit-up pools and sentiment cycles, avoiding AI hallucination.
Integrates AI specifically for synthesizing raw data into readable market commentary.
Designed for privacy and cost-efficiency by running entirely locally with support for subscription-based LLM access.
Provides actionable insights for quantitative traders focusing on market breadth and liquidity flow.

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically architected for quantitative trading research.
bullets: Utilizes a multi-agent orchestration pattern to separate research, strategy formulation, and backtesting.
Designed to automate the lifecycle of trading research from hypothesis generation to performance validation.
Provides a modular structure for integrating LLM reasoning into traditional quantitative finance workflows.
Focuses on scaling research throughput by leveraging agentic collaboration for strategy discovery.
